name: Cattle feed, maize silage (as fed)
source: As-fed composition (per kg): water 650 g (dry matter 350 g), of which protein 8%, fat 3%, ash 5% and carbohydrate/fibre by difference 84% of dry matter, typical of well-fermented whole-plant maize silage (dairy/beef ration tables).
notes: Dry-matter fractions are converted to as-fed fractions by multiplying through by the 350 g/kg dry-matter share, then run through the same protein/fat/carbohydrate/water elemental model as the wheat files. This is the feed input to the cattle account that a milk- or cream-producing chain must draw from, so that milk's carbon and nitrogen ultimately trace back to a modelled crop rather than appearing from nowhere.
